company.name: Pennine Freight & Logistics Ltd
company.description: Family-run general haulage and specialist transport operator based at Stourton in Leeds, running line-haul curtainsiders across the M62 corridor, ADR-compliant fuel and chemical tankers, heavy/crane plant movements and temperature-controlled reefer work. Holds a standard international operator (O) licence (OB1234567) for 40 vehicles and 55 trailers across two operating centres.

notes.author: Raj Patel (Northern Fuels)
notes.body: Confirm compartment plan before loading: 18,000L diesel in C1, 16,000L petrol split across C2/C3. Driver must present ADR transport documents at the gantry and connect bonding before any product transfer.

notes.author: Workshop foreman
notes.body: Scania R450 off road since Monday with a slipping clutch. Replacement clutch kit on order from dealer, fitting booked Thursday. Do not plan this unit for any work this week.

notes.author: Transport planner
notes.body: Abnormal load movement of the crane upper runs overnight under STGO Cat 2. VR1 notification VR1-2026-44871 acknowledged by West Yorkshire and West Midlands police. Escort van EV-02 to lead; banksman required at both ends.

notes.author: Compliance officer
notes.body: Marek's Driver CPC expires 02/12/2026. Book the final 7-hour periodic training module before the end of November to avoid him being unable to drive commercially.

notes.author: Liam O'Connor (driver)
notes.body: Sheffield RDC drop completed. Box temperature read 2.4C at the door, well within the 0-5C tolerance. Door open four minutes only. Goods-in signed the POD without query.

notes.author: Account manager
notes.body: Cranebuild now require 48 hours notice for all abnormal load collections so they can arrange crane availability and site access. Update booking rules accordingly.

notes.author: ADR controller
notes.body: Annual tanker test certificate on the Volvo FH valid to 31/03/2027. Earthing and bonding continuity last checked 12/05/2026, all in order. Orange plates and hazard panels in good condition.

notes.author: Transport planner
notes.body: Three-drop chilled run today. Remind driver to keep the reefer at 2C and minimise door-open time; the Sheffield RDC has a 45-minute maximum dwell so prioritise that drop.

notes.author: Cold chain supervisor
notes.body: Brief temperature excursion to 6.8C at the Sheffield drop caused by the door being held open. Reefer recovered to setpoint within six minutes; product unaffected, no rejection. Logged for the customer's quality records.

notes.author: Transport planner
notes.body: David Mensah on the Glasgow Class 8 run Saturday. Confirm his ADR tanker certificate (Class 3 only) is sufficient - sodium hydroxide is Class 8 so swap to Marek if needed. CHECK BEFORE DISPATCH.

notes.author: Driver supervisor
notes.body: Trafford fuel terminal now enforces gas detector PPE for all ADR drivers at the gantry. Make sure detectors are issued and calibrated before sending anyone to load.

notes.author: Driver - Gary Whitfield
notes.body: AdBlue ran low on Saturday's run, warning came up around junction 27. Topped up from the depot bunker on return. Tank gauge may be reading slightly optimistic, worth a check at next service.

notes.author: Workshop planner
notes.body: Reefer fridge unit (Carrier Vector 1550) service due 15/08/2026 or at next pre-cool fault, whichever sooner. Carrier engineer to attend on site; book a non-operational day for VEH-004.

notes.author: Port clerk
notes.body: Container MSCU7781234 cleared customs and available for collection from 29/06. Driver must carry a valid VBO card for the Gladstone gate; without it the port will refuse entry.

notes.author: Fleet engineer
notes.body: 45ft high-cube added to the container catalogue for a one-off project. No current vehicle is plated/equipped to carry it — leave it off every vehicle's compatible list until a skeletal extendable trailer is hired, otherwise dispatch will wrongly offer a truck.

notes.author: Transport planner
notes.body: WO-0016 cannot be assigned: the 45ft high-cube is not on any vehicle's carriage list, so the fit check hard-blocks every truck. Options — hire a skeletal trailer for VEH-003 or sub-contract the leg. Customer informed of a possible delay.

findings.outcome: Vehicle off road pending clutch replacement
